unresolved.which vowel each cell is: REFUSED. The sheets carry no label this archive can read. Three routes were measured: the Quenya sheet's two ink bands are 110px and 115px tall, so both are GLYPH rows and neither is a caption; tesseract on the Late Form's short bands returned English prose, which is a reader hallucinating on shapes it has no model for; and ordering by position is a guess, because Sarati sheets are not alphabetical and the same mark differs by valuation. WHAT WOULD SETTLE IT: the k-type test -- Amanyë Tenceli keys each valuation to a distinct k-shape and the archive holds Sarati_-_letter_k.png. That assigns each SHEET to a valuation, after which the order within it follows from Björkman's own tables.

note: Shapes, not sounds. The Scriptorium therefore still writes Sarati CONSONANTS and names every vowel as having no plate -- which is true, and better than a vowel drawn from a guess.
